defects.description: Description: Rest a SINGLE elbow on a high ledge — singular, one elbow on ledge. PR-v4 reverted both shoulders to -30 (symmetric abduction 53deg). Both elbows at same y=0.424 (below shoulder y=0.663). Symmetric shoulders contradict single-elbow-on-ledge posture. Right arm should be relaxed at-side, not raised.

Description: Prop the chin lightly on the raised hand. L wrist→neck dist2D=0.79, R wrist→neck dist2D=0.98 (threshold ~0.20). Neither hand near chin. The raised-hand-on-ledge side (L) should reach chin.
Elbows at y=0.424 (below shoulder y=0.663). For high ledge, elbow should be at shoulder height or above. Currently L shoulder abduction ~53deg (upper arm below horizontal).

failing_tests.assertion: left and right shoulder asymmetric for single-elbow pose
failing_tests.expected: L shoulder abducted ~90deg (elbow at shoulder height), R shoulder near 0 (at-side)

failing_tests.assertion: L wrist to neck dist2D < 0.20 for chin-prop

regression_risk: medium — large shoulder magnitude change (-30→-85) may interact with shoulderFwdL=-1 producing unexpected wrist position. Integrator should verify L wrist reaches chin via test render.
rationale: PR-v4 fix reverted both shoulders from -110 to -30 (overshoot corrected). However PR-v4 left them SYMMETRIC — description requires asymmetric (single elbow on ledge). Three coordinated changes: (1) leftShoulder -30→-85 (raise L upper arm to ~90deg abduction so L elbow reaches shoulder height ~0.66 = high-ledge height). (2) leftElbow 100→90 (right-angle flexion, L forearm horizontal pointing inward toward chin). (3) rightShoulder -30→0 (R arm relaxed at-side, asymmetric from raised L arm). With L upper arm horizontal + L forearm horizontal-inward, L wrist approaches neck/chin level for chin-prop. Spine=14, hips=16, leftHip=12 preserved.
